validated_objective: Release QIF v0.7.3 with an executable, domain-general Cross-Domain Transportability Review.
scope: Add canonical transportability policy, domain profile, domain-local result, transfer comparison, and assessment entities.
Extend verifier, schema, example, negative fixtures, authoring guide, roadmap, changelog, runtime log, and portable package.
constraints: Do not pool domain results into proof, infer causality, or grant operational authority.
Retain all existing v0.7.2 behavior and example-only boundaries.
expected_outcomes: Every transfer claim preserves source and target context and identifies exact matched and mismatched dimensions.
Unsupported or conditional transfer routes governance while domain-local results remain visible.
